event_chain.summary: Staff viewed tiger victim records without need

summary: After William Chapman, 23, died on October 10, 2026 after entering a tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, two Yorkshire Ambulance Service staff members inappropriately accessed or tried to access his medical records. The trust disclosed the potential breach in mid-October 2026 and the Health Secretary called for those responsible to be dismissed.
